mapper.select: SELECT id, perm_code, perm_name, perm_type, module, sort_no, create_time FROM sys_permission ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT perm_code FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY perm_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT rp.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rp.perm_code ASC
SELECT rp.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY rp.perm_code ASC
